sources.label: Official PrettyLittleThing size guide (Clothing, Main Range, CM view)

audit: Old /size-guide redirects to /pages/informational/size-guide. Official Main Range chart is UK 4–18 (stored went to 20; UK 20 is only in the Shape and Plus charts, so removed). Values are the site's own CM view (they match the inch chart × 2.54; low hip used for hips). Every row changed: UK 4 bust 76 → 80, waist 58 → 62.2, hips 82 → 87.6; UK 10 bust 88 → 90.2, waist 70 → 72.4, hips 94 → 97.8; UK 14 bust 96 → 100.3, waist 78 → 82.6, hips 102 → 108; UK 18 bust 106 → 110.5, waist 88 → 92.7, hips 112 → 118.1. US/CA as published (UK 4 = 0). EU removed: the chart's EU row just repeats the UK numbers, and its FR row (UK 4 = 32) is not a general EU size. Letter sizes from the header (XS = 4, S = 6–8, M = 10–12, L = 14–16, XL = 18) kept as altLabel. Petite, Tall, Shape, Plus and Maternity have separate charts, not included.
notes: UK ultra-fast fashion (Boohoo Group). Official Main Range chart covers UK 4–18 with bust, waist and low hip; Petite, Tall, Shape, Plus (to UK 28) and Maternity have their own charts. Sizing varies between garments, so check the item's own measurements.
